criteria.criterion: In this repository (module github.com/mvelosop/vloop), vloop doctor reports self-hosting as a warning with the message `this binary carries no commit — build releases with the stamped build in docs/guide/concepts.md` for a binary without a commit.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor.go:223-224 warns with the exact message for empty or "unknown" commit; gate checked the real binary.

criteria.criterion: A binary stamped with HEAD keeps the warning `this binary was built from HEAD — build the next vloop with a released one`; one stamped with another commit passes; outside this module the check is n/a.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go:225-228 keeps the HEAD warning, default case passes, first case gives n/a; TestDoctorSelfHosting covers n/a, pass (commit c010) and HEAD warning.

criteria.criterion: docs/guide/concepts.md documents the stamped release build (`-ldflags "-X main.version=<v> -X main.commit=<sha>"`) and the release steps: plugin.json version, tag, build.
criteria.evidence: concepts.md new section 'The stamped release build' has the ldflags command and the steps: plugin.json, tag, build.

criteria.criterion: internal/cli/doctor_test.go holds TestDoctorSelfHostingUnstamped and TestDoctorSelfHosting covers a stamped build of another commit passing; the new test fails against the base.
criteria.evidence: doctor_test.go:310-317 adds the test for "" and "unknown" expecting warning (base returned pass); existing TestDoctorSelfHosting asserts pass with Commit c010 and was not modified.
